clauses.text: there when the new school was founded
the first to read a subject that did not exist before them
taught in a department that closed under them
four years of bad news from the bursary
a class that went on to things
on the handsomest campus in the county

readings.warmth: How this class remembers the place, 0–100: set at graduation by the four years they had, and nudged after, never rewritten.
readings.memory: One line for their four years, stamped at graduation from what actually happened in them.
readings.giving: What this class gives the annual fund this year: their warmth and their means, rising as they get established.
readings.annualFund: Every class's giving, added up: the alumni ledger paying out, decades after the years that set it.
readings.given: What this class has given since they left.
readings.reunion: A reunion warms a class a little, and costs a little; a class can only be warmed so far, because the four years they had are not up for revision.

lines.reunionCapped: As warm as they will get
lines.noAlumni: Nobody has graduated yet. The ledger starts with the first class out.
lines.warmthNote: Warmth is set by the years they had. Reunions nudge it; nothing rewrites it.
